protocol.same_timestamp_policy: all events added before one evaluation per affected account; strict causal gate preserved
protocol.monetary_units: synthetic USD cents mapped losslessly to integer detector amount field; no INR conversion
protocol.preprocessing: verified SHA-256; all source transactions replayed in original chronological timestamp groups; source ID retained with namespace prefix
protocol.evaluation_scope: core production detector replay, not HTTP ingestion throughput or live UPI validation
